example.title: Tarr & Wonson Paint Manufactory chimney, Rocky Neck (1863)

brief: The tall square red-brick chimney of a waterfront copper-paint factory on a rocky point: a tapering brick stack beside a two-storey red-painted clapboard factory with 'MANUFACTORY' painted along it, standing on granite blocks at the water's edge. Three photos. Older than 1970: harbour boiler stacks of this kind are 19th-century; none newer. Foundations deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
